facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pip looked very serious now. "If hard times come, what then?" The friends were quiet for a moment. Wooly was first to speak. "We will help," she said clearly. Daisy and Gigi said it too. Penny gave a brave cluck. The animals promised to help.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pip looked around at his friends with serious eyes that seemed older than his small body. "When something hard happens — when one of us is scared, or lost, or alone — what will we do?" he asked softly. The animals were quiet for a long moment, listening to the wind in the leaves. Then Wooly was the first to break the silence. "We will help," she said firmly. Daisy lifted her head and added, "We will help." Gigi honked, "We will help." Penny clucked, "We will help." One by one, every voice promised the same brave word. The animals promised to help, and the air felt safer than it had ever been before.
